name: Marcy Kaptur

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BAR RUSSIAN OIL SALES
statements.title: BAR RUSSIAN OIL SALES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today at a moment of great consequence for our allies in Ukraine and the cause of liberty across the continent of Europe, all our closest allies.
The American people fully know that dictator Vladimir Putin is liberty's foe.
They know that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and the brave Ukrainian people are our allies in liberty.

Instead of pressuring Putin to end his war of aggression through the bipartisan sanctions this Congress passed, the Trump administration is taking sanctions off of Russia so that Russia can sell its Russian diesel here and make money to kill more Ukrainians, lots of innocent people--women, and children--in civilian areas.
The same Russian blood money is also being used by Putin to buy Iranian missiles that are killing American troops in the Middle East.
Congress passed legislation that any business or government entity that violates existing law and facilitates the purchase of Russian diesel will face real consequences.
Liberty has won for now, as Russian diesel tankers have been turned back from America's shores by the Governors of New Jersey and New York.
Going forward, Congress must formally kill illegitimate diesel deals and force our President to sanction Russia.

I continue to push for dual affiliation between our University of Toledo Medical Center and the Department of Veterans Affairs hospital system so that we can actually have the affiliation inside the State of Ohio rather than being one of the few States in the Union where you have to cross borders to get to a veterans hospital.
I will continue to fight for this funding to stay accessible to veterans who served in Vietnam, the Gulf war, and the Middle East conflicts of Iraq and Afghanistan.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRIUMPHAL ARCH CASTS A SHADOW ON ARLINGTON NATIONAL CEMETERY
statements.title: TRIUMPHAL ARCH CASTS A SHADOW ON ARLINGTON NATIONAL CEMETERY
sentences: The proposed 250-foot-tall arch would break up the beauty and carefully constructed site lines from the Lincoln Memorial to Arlington National Cemetery.
It would also impose shadows over the President John F. Kennedy Memorial, the Military Women's Memorial, and the grave sites of three Supreme Court Justices.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INTRODUCTION OF THE U.S. SWINE HEALTH IMPROVEMENT PLAN ACT OF 2026
statements.title: INTRODUCTION OF THE U.S. SWINE HEALTH IMPROVEMENT PLAN ACT OF 2026
sentences: The House of Delegates, composed of producers appointed by their State pork producer associations and of State animal health officials, votes each year on updates to the program's standards, which are then reviewed by the U.S. Department of Agriculture for adoption.

The bill I have introduced with my colleagues today, which is a companion to S. 4893 in the Senate, amends the Animal Health Protection Act to build upon the U.S. SHIP pilot program's success by Congressionally authorizing the program and institutionalizing it within the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
I urge my colleagues, including the leadership of the Committee on Agriculture, to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REIGNITING THE CALL TO HOLD JEFFREY EPSTEIN AND LES WEXNER ACCOUNTABLE
statements.title: REIGNITING THE CALL TO HOLD JEFFREY EPSTEIN AND LES WEXNER ACCOUNTABLE
sentences: On Saturday, October 17, 2026, I hosted a roundtable in Toledo, Ohio alongside the Democratic Women's Caucus and Chair Teresa Leger Fernandez to shed light on the corruption and abuse perpetrated by Jeffrey Epstein and Leslie Wexner.
Wexner employed Epstein as his financial advisor, thus entrusting him with his entire estate and granting him permission to buy and sell properties and other holdings on his behalf.
This status propelled Epstein into wealth and bankrolled his trafficking ring.
Without Wexner, there is no Epstein.

Epstein survivors Wendy Pesante, Marina Lacerda, and Jena-Lisa Jones participated in the roundtable to share their unique perspectives, as did local Toledo sex trafficking survivors Angela Navarro and Marie Fitzpatrick.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TARIFFS ON CANADA
statements.title: TARIFFS ON CANADA
sentences: The administration has now imposed more huge tariffs on the American people.
Tariffs are taxes on the American people.
Tariffs have already cost Ohioans in industry, agriculture, consumer goods, and tourism over $11 billion more in rising prices due to these tariffs since January of last year.
Consumers and producers must stand up against these destructive tariffs.
Let's get rid of these crippling tariffs, protect hardworking Americans, and preserve our valued friendships with our closest, reliable, fair trading partner in Canada. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AFFORDABLE CARE ACT HEALTHCARE ENROLLMENT DROPS
statements.title: AFFORDABLE CARE ACT HEALTHCARE ENROLLMENT DROPS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, reckless changes to the Affordable Care Act by this administration already have ripped away affordable healthcare coverage for 2 million Americans.

Between the cuts included in the big bonanza bill for billionaires and its refusal to extend the enhanced premium tax credits, it is clear the GOP's majority is intent on worsening this health insurance crisis for our relatives and neighbors.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TROOP DEATHS IN JORDAN AND IRAQ
statements.title: TROOP DEATHS IN JORDAN AND IRAQ
sentences: Last February, President Trump told us his undeclared war of choice on Iran was only supposed to last 4 days.
Curiously, in June, President Trump said: ``It is a little bit unfair for [Iran] not to have some'' ballistic missiles.
Billions of tax dollars are being spent and shifted by the Trump administration, ballooning our gaping Federal debt, without an approval vote by Congress.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JUSTICE FOR NORTHWEST OHIO RATEPAYERS
statements.title: JUSTICE FOR NORTHWEST OHIO RATEPAYERS
sentences: They were wronged for decades by the largest nuclear power corruption scandal in both American and Ohio history.
Nuclear power executives must be held accountable.
The Ratepayer Justice Act I just introduced yesterday would do just that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN, HORMUZ, INFLATION
statements.title: IRAN, HORMUZ, INFLATION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, today marks the 137th day of President Trump's undeclared war of choice on Iran.
The cost of this war is being borne by hardworking families all across our country, already costing them over $100 billion or more added to the U.S. debt.

He has turned the U.S. Navy into a traffic cop for the strait as his blockade resumed, and the Navy is charged with charging vessels 20 percent, a 20 percent tariff for passing through, which means prices are going up.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENSE INNOVATION WITH UKRAINE
statements.title: DEFENSE INNOVATION WITH UKRAINE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise tonight to spotlight the urgent need for deepened cooperation between the United States and Ukraine in defense innovation.
After over 10 years of Russia's brutal, unprovoked invasion of Ukraine, Ukraine has given the world a master class in the future of warfare.
Ukraine has pioneered drone tactics and technology.
Russia has 3.5 times as many people as Ukraine, but Ukraine fights on nobly.
Ukraine's ecosystem of innovation is a model that the free world can't afford to ignore.
This companion legislation to its Senate counterpart introduced by Senators Rosen and Rounds would establish a landmark strategic defense innovation working group with Ukraine and NATO.
Remember, Iran just killed American troops with the same weapons it tested with Russia.
Iran and Russia have a relationship, and then they used the technologies against Ukraine.
But it was Ukraine that came to our defense with its innovation in the Middle East.

Our sustained engagement now has attracted one of the leading manufacturers of unmanned systems: Ukrainian defense drones, the U.S. arm of Ukraine's F-Drones, to stand up assembly in Northwestern Ohio.
Already, our State of Ohio is well recognized as the home of aviation, of space exploration, and defense industrial base manufacturing.
Its systems have been battle-tested on the frontlines of liberty, defending the free people of Ukraine from Dictator Vladimir Putin's merciless and unprovoked invasion.
We helped defeat fascism in World War II, Soviet communism in the last century, and remain committed to liberty and to sustaining our NATO alliance against all enemies.

Our region stands ready to stay vigilant at creating a future to ensure jobs and industry leadership for Northwest Ohio's manufacturing workforce and making sure that China and other countries like Iran do not have the most sophisticated technology that is known to the world.
These include introducing today, my bipartisan Strategic Unmanned Systems Partnership Act to ensure America continues working with our Ukrainian allies on these vital issues.
I have heard many things from troops, but that has been one of their most constant clarion calls to Members of Congress, and we intend to deliver to them.
That is why today, I introduced the bipartisan Strategic Unmanned Systems Partnership Act--I underline bipartisan--along with Representatives Fitzpatrick, Quigley, McCaul, Costa, and Bacon.

Together, we will submit Northwestern Ohio as a critical drone manufacturing capital of America, and with Anduril's investment in Central Ohio, together we will meet our U.S. military's new needs at home and abroad.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: $1.8 BILLION SLUSH FUND
statements.title: $1.8 BILLION SLUSH FUND
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the billionaire bonanza bill that I didn't vote for has resulted in the slashing of health insurance for millions of our fellow citizens.
Moreover, that bill gave huge new tax breaks to billionaires.
I must ask President Trump why he unilaterally decided to give $1.8 billion in reparations to the bullies who attacked the Capitol on January 6.
Meanwhile, his Iran war is costing us about a billion dollars a day.
We are now into day 117, and the flimsy Iran deal seems to have fallen apart.
Who proposed $324 billion to Iran?
Congress should end these giveaways to billionaires and give tax refunds to the hardworking people of our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INFLATION AND SECRET PLAN TO CUT SOCIAL SECURITY, MEDICARE, AND MEDICAID
statements.title: INFLATION AND SECRET PLAN TO CUT SOCIAL SECURITY, MEDICARE, AND MEDICAID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, earlier this week news broke that ``you'' have a secret plan to cut Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.
The following day, as new numbers were released showing core inflation rose to 4.2 percent on everything, the President said he loves inflation.
I am sorry, but where I come from, our retired workers know that Social Security and Medicare are hard-earned benefits we all pay into.
Also, we know Medicaid is a lifeline for the most at-risk seniors to access healthcare or pay for long-term nursing care for those who can't afford it in their golden years.
I don't agree with Speaker Johnson's notion to cut Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE FOR TOLEDO'S OLD WEST END COMMUNITY
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE FOR TOLEDO'S OLD WEST END COMMUNITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise tonight because, over this weekend, my beloved hometown of Toledo, Ohio, suffered tragic and senseless gun violence in our storied Old West End community.
The Toledo Police and Fire Departments and all first responders proved their courage and utter devotion to duty and restored civil order.
Our community owes them a profound debt of gratitude for their selfless service.

I join our local law enforcement partners in asking anyone who might have footage or firsthand information to share that confidentially so that we can locate those perpetrators by calling Crime Stoppers at 419- 255-1111.
Together, we will find answers and a better road forward.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
statements.title: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank the fine ranking member from the State of New York, who has worked so very hard on this for the time this evening, and to all of our colleagues who support H.R. 2913, the Ukraine Support Act.
In 2014, without provocation, Russian dictator Vladimir Putin first invaded the sovereign nation of Ukraine.
The war-torn people of Ukraine are not asking us for charity.
We must not turn our backs on Ukraine's long-suffering people, especially over 20,000 children of Ukraine maliciously abducted by Russia and being inhumanely reprogrammed on Russian soil.
Now, Iran, in cahoots with Putin's Russia, makes the drones killing American soldiers in the Middle East.
It is Iranian-made suicide drones that Russia launches to murder thousands of Ukrainians in their homes and its soldiers at the front.
Ukraine has come to America's defense with its cutting-edge interceptor drones.
Now, will we come to Ukraine's aid?
The people of Ukraine fully know their fate is intertwined with our own.
A ``yes'' vote sanctions Putin's Russia, that dictatorship.

If we fail to secure liberty's front in Europe, the next strategic reality we will face is defending our interests against an emboldened, nuclear-armed, expansionist Russia at a much, much higher cost.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAILORS ANSWERED EVERY CALL
statements.title: SAILORS ANSWERED EVERY CALL
sentences: This deployment was repeatedly extended to support illegal and unconstitutional operations in Venezuela and Iran.
We must swiftly end this expensive war of choice in Iran while honoring the service of the men and women of the Gerald R. Ford.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: POLICE WEEK
statements.title: POLICE WEEK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to honor the brave men and women from police departments and law enforcement agencies throughout northwest Ohio and across our Nation.
We recognize them to thank them for their patriotism and to meet with them during this Police Week.
Recently, efforts like Elon Musk's DOGE tried to cut Federal funding for law enforcement by cutting COPS and Department of Justice grants to them.

Those efforts to cut funding are also why I joined my bipartisan Appropriations colleague Congresswoman Stephanie Bice of Oklahoma to introduce the Training Rural Law Enforcement Officers Act of 2026 to extend funding opportunities to trusted not-for-profits to train and support rural law enforcement.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HIGHLIGHTING WOMEN'S HEALTH
statements.title: HIGHLIGHTING WOMEN'S HEALTH
sentences: Today, I rise sincerely to thank 218 House bipartisan colleagues for signing Discharge Petition No. 8 in order to force a vote here on the floor for a long-overdue vote on the Ukraine Support Act.
Liberty for Ukraine and for NATO hangs in the balance.
For 12 years, Ukraine's people have valiantly endured Russia's savage war to eradicate Ukraine, its children, and Ukraine's very identity.
As today's forces continue liberating stolen territory, our bipartisan petition represents strong support for Ukraine's defense of liberty.
Vladimir Putin must stop and end his horrific invasion of a free nation.

Let me thank especially Congressmen Steny Hoyer, Don Bacon, Brian Fitzpatrick, Kevin Kiley, Mike Quigley, and all those in the Ukraine Caucus who have fought so long and hard in our bipartisan support for Ukraine that transcends party lines.
All 218 signatories have the gratitude of the American people, the whole of the Ukrainian nation, and freedom lovers around the world.

H.R. 2913--Ukraine Support Act summary This bipartisan legislation enhances security assistance to Ukraine while placing long overdue sanctions on Russia to force Vladimir Putin to end the war on Ukraine. ukraine security assistance Extends Lend-Lease authority through 2028.
Extends Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative.
Establishes new mechanisms to support Ukraine's recovery.
Vote yes on the Ukraine Support Act to pressure Russia to end its invasion of Ukraine.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING THE DESIGNATION OF THE WEEK OF MAY 8, 2026, THROUGH MAY 17, 2026, AS "NATIONAL AMERICAN BIRDING WEEK"
statements.title: SUPPORTING THE DESIGNATION OF THE WEEK OF MAY 8, 2026, THROUGH MAY 17, 2026, AS "NATIONAL AMERICAN BIRDING WEEK"
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of a bipartisan resolution that I am introducing with my Ohio colleague, Representative Robert E. Latta, proclaiming May 8, 2026, through May 17, 2026, as National American Birding Week.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: END THIS WAR
statements.title: END THIS WAR
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise tonight to speak of a crisis of the President's own creation due to his war of choice in Iran and the confusion that has caused.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LAKE ERIE'S WESTERN BASIN
statements.title: LAKE ERIE'S WESTERN BASIN
sentences: At a time when energy demand is rising and energy bills are up 13 percent, we must produce clean energy that lowers costs, creates jobs, and protects our air and water.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HUNGARIAN ELECTIONS
statements.title: HUNGARIAN ELECTIONS
sentences: For 16 years, Hungarians endured a cadre of kleptocrats that plundered their country and sold it out to the interests of Russian dictator Vladimir Putin.
Shocking tapes reveal how Orban's top officials plotted with Russia to undermine neighboring Ukraine and the rest of Europe and even help the Ayatollah in Iran.
The former Prime Minister's betrayal of the Hungarian people and the NATO Alliance is why Congressman Don Bacon and I introduced the BLOCK PUTIN Act to hold these corrupt officials accountable.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SKYROCKETING PRICE OF FERTILIZER AND DIESEL
statements.title: SKYROCKETING PRICE OF FERTILIZER AND DIESEL
sentences: After 2 years of record drought, a year of reckless Trump tariffs, their export markets are drying up abroad.
Mr. Speaker, 25 percent of the world's oil supply passes through this narrow channel off the Iranian coast.
On top of skyrocketing fertilizer costs, the national average for diesel just hit a record $5.37 per gallon.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STATE OF DOMESTIC OIL, DIESEL, AND GAS
statements.title: STATE OF DOMESTIC OIL, DIESEL, AND GAS
sentences: Diesel, the life blood of our supply system, is surging to nearly $5 a gallon, increasing transportation costs and driving up the cost of everything: food, manufacturing, and fertilizer across our heartland.
The cost of gasoline, diesel, and home heating is a daily burden on working families, farmers, truckers, and small businesses trying to keep their operations open.
The undeclared Trump illegal war on Iran makes the condition exponentially worse.
In Ohio, we refine, move, and deliver energy, but I will tell you, this is actually such a terrible tax on the American people causing the debt to go up.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COST OF TRUMP'S IRAN WAR
statements.title: COST OF TRUMP'S IRAN WAR
sentences: Mr. Speaker, on February 28, President Donald Trump made a unilateral decision to take the United States and the American people to war against the nation of Iran.
Iran is a nation of 93 million people with sophistication and fundamentalist religious leaders that imbue Iran's actions intergenerationally.
Iran holds influence across millions of adherents, even across its borders.

Without any consultation and in direct violation of congressional war powers in our Constitution that belongs to the people of the United States, not just the President, our Nation is now at war with a religious state.
Last week, Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky was quoted as saying he would oppose any Iran supplemental.
I can comment that as planting season is upon us, diesel and fertilizer costs are through the roof, and our farmers, producers, and growers are really feeling it.
The President has already in his first and now second administrations added over $6 trillion to America's debt, and it is rising.
To conduct this undeclared war on Iran and apparently adjoining countries, the Trump administration is increasing our debt and borrowing even more money from China to spend against Iran.
China, looking at our debt accounts, can ask for payment on those bonds at any time.
At the same time, with the billions of defense dollars being spent in the Middle East, too many of our global assets are being repositioned from the Pacific and the European NATO commitment.
I can guarantee you our Defense Appropriations Subcommittee has not approved a single penny of this spending for the war on Iran.
Our debt gets worse every day, and since he took office 14 months ago, our national debt has ballooned to $39 trillion.

They are already seeing it in the price of essentials like food, gas, fertilizer for our farmers, medical care, diesel, energy prices, water prices are going up, and housing is unaffordable and rising every day.
He worked diligently for months and months, and I daresay years, at that astounding achievement of a peace agreement between Egypt and Israel.
We are asking where has the President emptied the accounts to pay for this war?
I urge President Trump's associates to contact the Carter Center and identify some of those who are currently living and participated in that extraordinary achievement and seek their advice.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WAR IN IRAN
statements.title: WAR IN IRAN
sentences: Instead of addressing any one of these critical issues here at home, this weekend, the Trump-Vance administration singularly launched a regime-change war on Iran.
As a cosponsor of the Iran War Powers Resolution, I know that no such vote was called in either Chamber of Congress prior to this profound and unprecedented military action.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRESIDENT TRUMAN'S WORDS STILL RING TRUE TODAY; THE FAILINGS OF THE STATE OF THE UNION
statements.title: PRESIDENT TRUMAN'S WORDS STILL RING TRUE TODAY; THE FAILINGS OF THE STATE OF THE UNION
sentences: While this speech is over 50 years old, the sentiments still remain today, as highlighted by the President's recent State of the Union.
Ill- considered tariffs have cost every hardworking family more than $1,750 and caused untold inflation which is making everyday life unaffordable.
They favor a minimum wage--the smaller the minimum the better.
They approve of social security benefits--so much so that they took them away from almost a million people.
They believe in international trade--so much so that they crippled our reciprocal trade program, and killed our International Wheat Agreement.
Since they won't tell you themselves, I am going to tell you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPREME COURT TARIFF DECISION
statements.title: SUPREME COURT TARIFF DECISION
sentences: They carry the heavy burden of President Trump's reckless trade war.
Tariffs hit our region harder than almost anywhere in our country.
Small retailers, restaurants, and childcare centers face higher costs they cannot absorb.
Every family pays more at the checkout counter, and tariffs and reckless trade wars raise prices.
The Supreme Court affirmed that our Constitution still matters and President Trump overstepped his authority.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WINNERS OF THE GLOBAL ENERGY RACE ARE BEING DECIDED
statements.title: WINNERS OF THE GLOBAL ENERGY RACE ARE BEING DECIDED
sentences: In Ohio, rapid demand growth from Big Tech data centers are also pushing up energy costs before the public, the people who live in these areas, can even catch the wind that they can actually try to figure out and have meetings and say: Hey, wait a minute, what can we do about this?
Just this last year, there were 354 clean energy projects or companies that the new administration canceled--new projects--delaying new investments.
There is no question that over 173,000 clean energy jobs actually have been eliminated between President Trump's election and swearing-in and February of this year.

The ten top States that have lost the most jobs from this misguided assault on clean energy are the following: Texas, Massachusetts, Arizona, New Jersey, Michigan, New York, South Carolina, Illinois, North Carolina, and my home State of Ohio.
While at the national level, the rise in energy rates is affecting people in every single State in our Union.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENDING THE TRUMP TARIFF ON CANADA
statements.title: ENDING THE TRUMP TARIFF ON CANADA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I was privileged to join colleagues from both sides of the aisle this week in the House vote that was overwhelming in bipartisan fashion to end the damaging Trump tariff regime on Canada.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING SOCIAL SECURITY
statements.title: PROTECTING SOCIAL SECURITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to celebrate Social Security.
The Trump administration and their approach threatens the Social Security Administration's ability to operate.
In my district alone, there was an 11 percent decrease in Social Security field office workers.
I want to say to every single public employee who works in a Social Security office across this country that they are patriots.

Meanwhile, the Social Security Administration says they are not closing any offices; but the so-called Department of Government Efficiency, DOGE, is attempting to weaken and dismantle a system which has stood tall for almost a century, created by Franklin Delano Roosevelt.
DOGE not only threatens Social Security by removing vital staff across our country but by mistreating and exposing beneficiaries' private and personal information.
Social Security information has always been private until now.
Social Security is often the only resource that keeps our seniors out of poverty.
For more than 7 million Americans over the age of 65, at least 90 percent of their income comes from Social Security, which they earned.
Of those 7 million, almost half would not be able to afford essentials such as food, housing, and clothing without Social Security benefits.
Now due to tariffs and inflation caused by Trump, those costs continue to go up, up, and up for everybody including seniors.

Every county in Ohio has at least 20 percent of its population receiving some form of Social Security benefits, and this means Social Security plays a huge role economically in northwestern Ohio's economy.

Standing up for our region and our seniors is one of my highest priorities in Congress, and that is why last year, when Social Security celebrated its 90th birthday, I introduced a resolution to demonstrate continued support from Congress for this program.
Raising the retirement age would reduce benefits for millions of Americans, placing an unnecessary burden on seniors and those who are close to retirement.
I promise to oppose any changes to the retirement age for these vital, national retirement, disability, and insurance programs.
That is only fair, but that FICA tax will go into Social Security.

I thank all of our colleagues who joined in supporting my resolution and urge others to consider supporting this resolution, which demonstrates the House of Representatives' dedication to protecting retirement security by not raising the retirement age.
I support strengthening Social Security, not cutting and gutting it.
Mr. Speaker, I end with Social Security is a sacred trust from one generation to the next, and we intend to keep it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: A PLEA FOR SMALL, FAMILY-OWNED FARMS
statements.title: A PLEA FOR SMALL, FAMILY-OWNED FARMS
sentences: Over the past year, they have endured setback after setback--including during the driest spells we have witnessed in more than a decade--due to tariffs, losing markets all across the world, and we think permanently.
The severity of this physical, as well as tariff, drought runs straight through our district.
We don't need recklessly imposed tariffs that break their backs due to lost export markets and then paying Argentina $40 billion for their beef when our cattlemen are going out of business.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: APPLAUDING PRESIDENT ZELENSKYY'S ADDRESS IN DAVOS
statements.title: APPLAUDING PRESIDENT ZELENSKYY'S ADDRESS IN DAVOS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, please allow me to begin by applauding President Zelenskyy of Ukraine on his exceptional and historic remarks in Davos, Switzerland, earlier today.

They all know that today's spider web of tyranny is spinning and stretching its ugly net from Russia to Brazil, India, North Korea, and South Africa, seeking a global necklace of repression and domination.
It is your voice that history will remember, rising to energize our world forward from inside the grim, fierce cauldron of struggle that is Ukraine.
Indeed, his words were empty because his administration's reckless tariffs and disastrous trade wars have increased manufacturing job losses not just in our region of Ohio but across our Nation.
The Trump administration's reckless tariffs and disastrous trade wars are straining the pocketbooks of our workers, farmers, and consumers.
Vice President Vance says he is now interested in lowering drug prices, but his party consistently voted against those efforts, which were championed under a prior Democratic administration.
I know because I voted to help cap insulin costs at $35 a month for seniors on Medicare.
I voted for prescription drug negotiations that are saving seniors thousands of dollars as we speak here tonight.

Another $28.5 million was taken away from our region via rescissions over the summer for major repair work in the heart of our city on Front and Main Street, on the side of the river that he traveled to.

Those investments were critical to American manufacturing, with new-age furnaces and technology, not only to compete with foreign glass producers but also to help reduce emissions here at home for the people who work in those plants and to make work safer for our workers.
So do truckers and working families paying more for groceries and at the pump just to haul goods, get to work, and move around their communities.

It was during that time that alongside myself, Sherrod, and others that Steve helped lead the consequential fight against NAFTA on this very floor, the North American Free Trade Agreement, which was anything but free to America's workers and farmers.
This was embodied in legislation he drafted to add an international designation to the Detroit River and Ottawa National Wildlife Refuges, which border our dear neighbor to the north, Canada.
He later dedicated over four decades to the Toledo Police Department.
His work earned him countless honors including induction into the Birmingham Hall of Fame and the National Law Enforcement Officer Hall of Fame.
For over 30 years, Papa Rex made Halloween camping trips legendary.
For more than four decades, this truly good man helped clothe our police officers, firefighters, workers, building Superior Uniform Sales with grit, wisdom, and a gift for bringing people together.
Let me just say to the Speaker, ``please, shake a leg.'' Honoring Steven D. Fought Mr. Speaker, I will move on now to remember someone that was an extraordinary American.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MANUFACTURING JOBS LOST DUE TO TRUMP TARIFFS
statements.title: MANUFACTURING JOBS LOST DUE TO TRUMP TARIFFS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to draw attention to the 68,000 manufacturing jobs lost across our country in 2025 as a direct result of President Trump's reckless tariffs and DOGE cuts.
Why did he visit Detroit yesterday when his insistence on continuing these tariffs actually cuts investment in American manufacturing?
In December, manufacturing jobs continued an 8-month decline that began after President Trump falsely promised these new tariffs would lead to an economic resurgence for American workers.
Instead, his broad across-the-board tariffs have driven prices up for everyday goods and all supply chains.
Tariffs create uncertainty in the job market, leaving hardworking families worse off.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RUSSIAN AIR ATTACK ON KYIV
statements.title: RUSSIAN AIR ATTACK ON KYIV
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise this evening to speak of a grave act that took place last week in the capital of Ukraine, Kyiv.
The Putin dictatorship continues its illegal war with a double crime--a double- tap strike attack.

Sadly, dictator Vladimir Putin's criminality against a free nation is nothing new, and Ukraine has repeatedly seen double-tap strikes specifically targeting first responders over the past 4 years, with over 500 killed.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UPLIFTING SPIRIT OF OLYMPIC SKATER MAXIM NAUMOV
statements.title: UPLIFTING SPIRIT OF OLYMPIC SKATER MAXIM NAUMOV
sentences: Maxim's dedication as a genuine athletic ice artist inspires every young American to a higher purpose.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXTENDING ACA TAX CREDITS
statements.title: EXTENDING ACA TAX CREDITS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise to applaud the House's extension of the enhanced Affordable Care Act premium tax credits for an additional 3 years.
Meanwhile, just months ago, these same Republican leaders gave an average tax cut of $80,000 to every millionaire in this country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Our bill aims to help address significantly rising energy and water bills coast to coast for families, as well as climate-caused water shortages in the West and across our Nation, with crop losses from coast to coast and increasing flooding across our beloved country.
We must also assure technologies like artificial intelligence and data centers don't bankrupt the ability of families to afford to live, nor take our society down dangerous roads without a roadmap.
Every dollar counts to make ends meet nowadays in an era marred by ill- considered Trump-inflicted tariffs that make living in America more expensive as prices rise.

sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to oppose the big elephant in the room, the Trump administration's imposition of a 25 percent tariff on U.S.-Canada trade.
President Trump is going to put a 25 percent tariff on U.S.-Canadian trade.
Unneeded tariffs will cause prices to rise more on everything.
Let me state plainly that 25 percent tariffs on Canada are foolish.
The people and businesses of our region and the industrial Midwest overwhelmingly oppose the administration's unnecessary trade war with Canada.
Tariffs can be imposed in a smart and targeted approach.
The Trump tariff is nothing like that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: If we look at what is happening with this current budget, it is a bonanza for billionaires.

To take away the healthcare, Medicare, Medicaid, the cuts that Republicans are proposing, you will cause death in this country.

I represent a lot of Republicans, and I will tell you they are honest people and they will pay their taxes, but they don't like this excess.

statements.title: THREE-YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF RUSSIA'S BRUTAL ATTACK ON UKRAINE

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE SCRIMMAGE LINE FOR LIBERTY
statements.title: THE SCRIMMAGE LINE FOR LIBERTY
sentences: Madam Speaker, Ukraine is the scrimmage line for liberty on the continent of Europe today.
We all have witnessed hundreds of thousands of war deaths at record levels in this 11-year, cruel war that Russia has perpetrated against the free nation of Ukraine.
For 30 years, Ukraine had tried to build her land forward.

Importantly, this morning in Europe, U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth made an opening statement, along with many of our allied nations, seeking an end to the horrific 11-year killing field that is Ukraine after war criminal Vladimir Putin's illegal invasion, as I said, in 2014.
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated a negotiated peace will require an exchange of territory.
Working with our closest and most-valued allies in NATO in the free world, the United States must do everything possible to bring full liberty to Ukraine and move Russia back into her own borders.
Trade war panic is causing more inflation.

With Democrats here in the House, President Biden was able to allow a few prescription drug prices to be lowered, but it is no secret that the majority of families struggle to pay for medicine when they need it.

statements.title: STANDING WITH UKRAINE
sentences: Madam Speaker, today, I stand with the long-suffering people of Ukraine.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TARIFFS AND TRADE
statements.title: TARIFFS AND TRADE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the people of northwest Ohio and the Great Lakes region, which is heavily industrial and agricultural, overwhelmingly oppose the Trump administration's ill-conceived trade war with Canada, Ohio's top fair trade partner and our largest fair trade partner.

Apparently there is a plan for a 1-month pause with this tariff relationship with Canada, but remember, Canada has been critical to the automotive industry, the lumber industry, the oil industry, the truck industry, every single industry you can think of, and now we are not sure what is going to happen in 1 month.
The administration's imposition of tariffs across our Great Lakes region adds up to a big lollapalooza-sized mistake.
Rising tariffs will put a brake on our region's economy and strong, two-way trade partnership.
They put a 25 percent tariff at the northern border, right, but with China it is 10 percent.
All those billionaires simply love shipping our jobs to penny-wage nations, and I am truly surprised President Trump has joined them.
Great Lakes region economic growth across the U.S.-Canadian border has been hard-fought, not exploitative.
Middle-class jobs have grown here, albeit far too slowly, and tariffs will cause a downdraft on economic growth, rising prices, and lost jobs.
Imposing tariffs on North American companies that are struggling to meet penny- wage global competition is driving our economy backwards.
As a result of Trump's tariffs, the prices and costs of doing business already are rising.
Across our Great Lakes States of Pennsylvania, Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, Wisconsin, Illinois, New York, and Minnesota, let our people remember President Trump's ill-conceived tariff edict.
Our region will work with any President and Prime Minister to reinvest in our Nation's industrial and agricultural base.
Why not focus tariffs on China where the trade gap is enormous and there is no fair trade, or Mexico where the wages and the gap of wages is horrendous compared to our country?
Rising tariffs will only cripple economic growth here, and the Trump administration has just shot itself in the foot again.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENHANCE PENALTIES FOR ASSAULTS ON LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS
statements.title: ENHANCE PENALTIES FOR ASSAULTS ON LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the pardons this week of violent felons who attacked our Capitol, injuring 174 of our Capitol Police, were a sacrilege against our Republic and our Constitution.
Mr. Speaker, 140 law enforcement officers were assaulted and 174 sustained injuries.
Those who engage in violence against law enforcement officers must be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law.
I will soon introduce the Brian Sicknick Heroic Law Enforcement Officers Protection Act.
This bill aims to strengthen penalties for those who assault law enforcement officers on Federal property.
This legislation is named in honor of U.S. Capitol Police Officer Brian Sicknick.
He tragically lost his life in the line of duty defending this Capitol on January 6, 2021.
My legislation will include enhanced penalties for assaults on law enforcement officers for individuals who assault officers on Federal property, with potential sentences including life imprisonment.
It will guarantee full health benefits throughout their service and retirement and for those injured in the line of duty, including the 140 officers assaulted and 174 injured on January 6, 2021.
As one Member who was held against her will in this Capitol on January 6, 2021, I can guarantee you this bill deserves swift passage.
The brave men and women of law enforcement put their lives on the line every day to protect our communities and our Nation.
